Nata fra le officine dei Bacini, Orvane: Born among the Basin workshops, Orvane favors compact dimensions and replaceable parts. Its ranges share a simple geometric language suited to later transformations.
Lethari recupera il linguaggio delle cor: Lethari revisits the old foundry races: extended hoods, compact cabins and circular details. Its classic sports cars use the same modular compatibility as modern cars.
Renvyx progetta berline per le strade de: Renvyx designs sedans for the canal streets. Long wheelbases, regular proportions and prominent cabins distinguish a range seeking balance between power and stability.
Caldorva nasce sulle terrazze di Hillcre: Caldorva comes from the Hillcrest terraces. Tall bodies, sturdy edges and roof rails accompany heavier vehicles with wide tracks and dedicated braking.
Le piccole botteghe delle Torri hanno da: The small Tower workshops shaped Ystren. Its range focuses on coupes, with short cabins, low roofs and quicker response than sedans.
Veylune lavora presso gli hangar di Nace: Veylune works near the Nacelle hangars. Low wedges and dark inserts define lightweight supercars with long ratios and lower resistance for fast straights.
Arqessa conserva la memoria delle compet: Arqessa preserves the memory of dockside competition. Its classic range uses circular lights and separate surfaces, reinterpreted with current suspension and customization modules.
Tyvoro tratta ogni auto come un prototip: Tyvoro treats each car as a Tower prototype. Narrow cabins, side fairings and prominent wings accompany a lightweight range designed for speed and precision.
Drevalyn costruisce monoposto presso lo: Drevalyn builds single-seaters near the freight terminal. A central seat, exposed wheels and separate wings reveal the chassis; the range favors low mass and direct response.
Ossyra viene dalle botteghe delle Lanter: Ossyra comes from the Lantern workshops. Its compacts have upright cabins and small dimensions, with wheelbase and track choices for drivers who prefer narrow passages.
Neralith disegna vetture da viaggio per: Neralith designs grand tourers to cross all of Port Riders. Long cabins and extended proportions accompany a sedan range with more mass and power than compacts.
Uldessa serve la cintura degli hangar. L: Uldessa serves the hangar belt. Its raised sports cars combine horizontal edges, equipped roofs and wide bodies; appearance modules remain replaceable on every car.
